sourceTitle: Fresh Fruit Salad With Creamy Banana Dressing
sourceText:
Fresh Fruit Salad With Creamy Banana Dressing
By: Tracy Wilson
Published: Thursday, May 5, 2011 - 7:35am

Ingredients




2 oranges, peeled and sectioned
1 cup fresh strawberries, halved (I quartered mine)
1 cup red apple, chopped (I just used the whole apple)
1 ripe banana
1/2 cup cottage cheese
3 tablespoons orange juice (I didnt have orange, so I used pineapple)
1 tablespoon honey
1/2 tablespoon poppy seeds

Preparation

1 In a medium bowl combine oranges, strawberries, and apple. Place remaing ingredients except poppy seeds in food processor and puree. Chill and mix with fruit. 2 Makes approximately 1 cup dressing.
